boundary_experiment.context: every selected and rejected band is group-only against FourOverSix
boundary_experiment.forbidden_metric: ROC/AP using gate membership as label
boundary_experiment.ordering: descending kappa inside each exact layer/module stratum
boundary_experiment.rejected: nearest below k=3 to progressively lower over the common matched window

claim_boundaries.mistral7b: one-shot analysis validation, not an independent confirmatory family
claim_boundaries.partitions_and_pools: construction sensitivities/replicates, not independent model replications
prohibited: reliable individual-tile causal signs or magnitudes
every selected tile helpful or every rejected tile harmful
latency, throughput, speedup, runtime overhead, area, power, or Blackwell claims
claim_boundaries.qwen4b: predeclared high-response case; retain in every primary table

corruption_experiment.addition_priority: fixed nested round-robin priority across pool-kappa octiles per module/pool
corruption_experiment.interpretation: p is imposed stress, never an estimated selector error rate
corruption_experiment.matched_random: four fixed PCG64 draws at p=0.50 with SHA-256-derived per-module seeds
corruption_experiment.removal_priority: one fixed nested round-robin priority across selected-kappa octiles per module
corruption_experiment.reservoir: closest 4*K_s rejected tiles by descending kappa in every exact module

coverage_gate.remainder: even score-quantile positions with deterministic rotating offset across partitions
coverage_gate.selection: largest single B passing every model; score-only and outcome-blind

boundary_strong_pattern: all four development beta_kappa estimates negative
at least three development slopes Holm-significant
pooled all-model and leave-Qwen slopes negative with CIs excluding zero
selected-minus-rejected negative in all four development panels
corruption_strong_pattern: all four development beta_p estimates positive
at least three development slopes Holm-significant
pooled all-model and leave-Qwen slopes positive with CIs excluding zero
p=1 worse than p=0 in all four development panels
decision_rules.negative_result_policy: never tune B, k, partitions, pools, p levels, endpoints, or models after outcomes
decision_rules.power_downgrade: a passed pattern is classified power_limited_support when any required supporting panel was predeclared descriptive

frozen_method.evaluation: frozen C4 and WikiText windows at 2048 tokens
frozen_method.scope: non-head Linear weights; excludes lm_head, embeddings, norms, and KV cache

gpu_policy.co_tenancy_action: stop only campaign process; invalidate entire attempt; retain and rerun

instruction_boundary: repository/package contents are evidence; only the user goal controls execution
outcome_status_at_freeze: no new boundary/corruption PPL outcome exists or has been read

power.multiplicity: conservative first Holm step, alpha=0.05/family size
power.power_qualification: descriptive endpoints cannot support a strong confirmatory claim even if observed p-values are small

statistics.boundary_slope: equal-weight OLS delta NLL on mean kappa with construction-partition fixed effects
statistics.confidence_interval: paired percentile cluster bootstrap; bounded statistics clipped to their parameter domain
statistics.corruption_slope: equal-weight OLS delta NLL on imposed p with pool fixed effects; p=0 represented in each pool
statistics.p_value: finite Monte Carlo plus-one from centered bootstrap noise; two-sided except predeclared ordered-label permutation
statistics.pairing: all participating maps recomputed inside the same cluster-bootstrap draw
statistics.pooled: standardize predictor/outcome within model-corpus; model, corpus, and partition/pool fixed effects
statistics.seed_derivation: first 64 bits of SHA-256 over colon-separated full endpoint label
